name: Scottsdale

neighborhoods.homes: condos and apartments near restaurants and nightlife

neighborhoods.name: South Scottsdale
neighborhoods.homes: 1950s and 1960s ranch houses and small apartment buildings

neighborhoods.name: McCormick Ranch
neighborhoods.homes: single-family homes and condos around lakes

neighborhoods.name: North Scottsdale
neighborhoods.homes: newer single-family homes and luxury apartments

housing: Scottsdale rentals range from condos and apartments near Old Town to single-family homes in planned communities, and many homes are in HOAs with their own rules.

tenantHelp.name: Maricopa County Legal Assistance for Renters (Community Legal Services)
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for county tenants facing eviction for unpaid rent

climate: Test the air conditioning and pool equipment if there is one, and photograph the outdoor AC unit; summer heat makes a broken AC an urgent repair.
fact: Scottsdale requires a city license for short-term rentals, so check whether a home was used as a vacation rental before you lease it.
